outgoingFlows.description: Transmission of Vibrio cholerae through contact, modulated by seasonally varying transmission parameter and potentially environmental reservoir
Vaccination with oral cholera vaccine (OCV), providing protection against infection or clinical disease
Recovery from cholera infection, conferring temporary natural immunity
Loss of natural immunity after infection, returning to susceptible state
Waning of vaccine-induced protection over time, with no protection assumed after 5 years
